title: Rent Negotiation
summary: A tenant and landlord negotiate repairs and a rent increase with polite but firm language.

lines.speaker: Inquilina
lines.pt: Dona Sônia, recebi o aviso de reajuste, mas gostaria de conversar antes de assinar o novo contrato.
lines.en: Dona Sônia, I received the notice of adjustment, but I would like to talk before signing the new contract.

lines.speaker: Proprietária
lines.pt: Claro, Júlia. O aumento segue o índice previsto, mas estou disposta a ouvir sua proposta.
lines.en: Of course, Júlia. The increase follows the expected index, but I am willing to hear your proposal.

lines.speaker: Inquilina
lines.pt: Entendo o índice. Ainda assim, o apartamento precisa de reparos: a torneira vaza e a janela do quarto não fecha direito.
lines.en: I understand the index. Even so, the apartment needs repairs: the faucet leaks and the bedroom window does not close properly.

lines.speaker: Proprietária
lines.pt: Você deveria ter me avisado antes. Posso mandar alguém verificar esta semana.
lines.en: You should have told me earlier. I can send someone to check this week.

lines.speaker: Inquilina
lines.pt: Agradeço. Se os reparos forem feitos, aceito parte do reajuste, mas não o valor completo.
lines.en: I appreciate it. If the repairs are made, I accept part of the increase, but not the full amount.

lines.speaker: Proprietária
lines.pt: Que tal dividirmos a diferença por seis meses e revisarmos depois?
lines.en: How about we split the difference for six months and review it afterward?

lines.speaker: Inquilina
lines.pt: Parece justo, desde que o prazo dos reparos fique registrado por escrito.
lines.en: That seems fair, as long as the repair deadline is recorded in writing.

lines.speaker: Proprietária
lines.pt: Combinado. Vou atualizar o contrato e enviar ainda hoje.
lines.en: Agreed. I will update the contract and send it today.

comprehension.question: Why does Júlia want to negotiate?
What problems does she mention?
options: A leaking faucet and a window that does not close
A broken elevator and noisy neighbors
comprehension.answer: A leaking faucet and a window that does not close

comprehension.question: What compromise is suggested?
options: Split the difference for six months
comprehension.answer: Split the difference for six months

comprehension.question: What condition does Júlia require?
options: The repair deadline must be in writing
The rent must be paid in cash
The owner must visit every day
comprehension.answer: The repair deadline must be in writing
